turns.doctor_question: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, occupational health at work sent me in. They're saying my weight is dangerously low for someone who runs presses and does metal fabrication all day. 

I... I don't really see it that way. I honestly thought I was just getting leaner and more disciplined, to be honest. But they insisted I come see you, so here I am.

symptom_reasoning.S044: The patient reports that occupational health stated their weight is dangerously low.
symptom_reasoning.S084: The patient does not recognize the seriousness of their low weight, stating they don't see it that way and thought they were just getting leaner.

turns.doctor_question: During the periods when you are maintaining this low weight, do you ever engage in episodes of binge eating followed by self-induced vomiting or the misuse of laxatives or diuretics?
turns.patient_response: No, I don't do any of that. I've never... I don't make myself throw up or take laxatives or anything like that. And I definitely don't binge eat. I just keep a really strict handle on what I take in.

symptom_reasoning.S043: The patient states they keep a really strict handle on what they take in, indicating strict restriction of food intake.
symptom_reasoning.S048: The patient explicitly denies making themselves throw up or taking laxatives.
symptom_reasoning.S049: The patient explicitly denies engaging in binge eating.
